cases.title: Retrieve a bottle from the refrigerator
cases.prompt: The robotic gripper retrieves the deep red glass bottle from the refrigerator.
cases.what_to_watch: Watch the grasp, the bottle leaving the refrigerator, and object continuity.

cases.title: Close the file cabinet drawer
cases.prompt: The robotic gripper closes the file cabinet drawer.
cases.what_to_watch: Watch gripper contact and whether the drawer closes along its track.
